title: Handoff layers preserve planning granularity and are re-read before commit
failure_signature: A schema-valid handoff repeats one narrow blocker or next action across strategic horizon, cursor, campaign, workstream and ordered-action fields, or carries stale live/admission state, causing a fresh Agent to tunnel into the latest local task and miss the intended owner/history route.
root_cause: The typed layers were introduced to preserve different planning horizons, but handoff writing became field-by-field and validation checked presence rather than whole-document semantic separation. Without a mandatory post-write reread, narrow tasks can collapse several layers into paraphrases and live fields can survive after their applicability changes.
invariant: Every substantive handoff is a write-reread-normalize transaction. Preserve the original semantic scale of strategic horizon, workstream, cursor, campaign and CI fields; treat the cursor as the sole owner of the immediate task/next atomic action; refresh live facts without converting unobserved state into fact; reopen capability admission when a new material change falls outside the current admission; then re-read the final live target ref. Use continuity_sequence as the only scheduled Fresh-Agent drill counter and proactively raise every tenth handoff.
anti_regression: Do not flatten strategic horizon, workstream and cursor into one TODO even when the current blocker is narrow.
Do not use bootstrap_instruction as a mini-devlog or duplicate current campaign/commit narrative that already has typed owners.
Do not consider schema validity sufficient; re-read the complete final handoff and remove semantic duplication or stale live state before commit.
Do not create a second mutable drill counter; scheduled cadence is derived from continuity_sequence.
Do not let a same-Agent rehearsal satisfy the every-tenth genuine Fresh-Agent drill requirement.
Manual or event-triggered drills may happen at any time but do not reset the fixed every-ten sequence cadence.

guards.description: Handoff contract tests require the closing-Agent semantic reread rule to remain visible and keep bootstrap_instruction procedural.
Fresh-Agent drill tests pin the every-ten continuity_sequence cadence and manual-trigger non-reset rule.
Every substantive session sees the write-reread-normalize closing discipline from the normal bootstrap path.

revisit_when: Revisit only if handoff generation becomes transactionally derived from stronger typed state with an independently verified semantic recovery test, so manual whole-document reread and explicit cadence are no longer needed to prevent granularity or freshness drift.
